scope: Qwen4Exp gfx1151 request-owned per-layer stateless MoE graph replay

implementation.change: Wrap each already-layer-wide c1 MoE call in the existing self-validating MoeGraphCache. Forty-eight graphs bind layer-specific weights plus request-owned scratch; only stateless router/selected experts/shared expert/combine are captured. GDN, QSA, PLE, GR, KV/index state, lm-head, and sampling remain eager.
implementation.fallback: HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_MOE_GRAPH=0 or any capture/parity failure runs the exact eager chain

paired_complete_model.protocol: one residency; capture/self-validate 48 graphs, warm graph+eager, then counterbalanced E/G/G/E/E/G; every row reset + p1 + 8 warm + 32 measured greedy tokens; full-logit SHA at every step

graph_accounting.note: Kernel dispatches inside graphs remain visible to kernel tracing; graph launch count comes from cache accounting/self-validation, not kernel-dispatch row count.

direct_wall_decomposition.interpretation: The former ~55 ms wall-minus-kernel estimate is not logits D2H/NumPy argmax. Nearly all unprofiled step wall lies before the existing sync, including kernels and inter-launch/submission stalls. rocprof tracing inflates those stalls and is not used as an unprofiled host-time claim.

focused_validation.command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 uv run pytest -q tests/test_moe_graph_cache.py tests/test_gfx1151_backend.py::test_gfx1151_scopes_qwen4_exp_moe_graph_replay tests/test_qwen4_exp_runner_moe.py tests/test_qwen4_exp_resident_serving.py tests/test_generation_qwen4_exp_gguf.py -x

decision: Promote as exact gfx1151 default. This is the primary decode structural win; continue kernel/grid work and whole-step submission contraction without graphing stateful GDN/QSA.
